text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The evidence directly contradicts the claim, showing that CD4+3−RANKL+ inducer cells signal through RANK on CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors to promote their maturation into CD80+Aire+ mTECs. RANK-deficient thymic stroma transplanted into immunodeficient hosts induced autoimmunity, and the appearance of these inducer cells is temporally linked to Aire+ mTEC emergence. Thus RANK-RANKL signalling is causally associated with the development of Aire-expressing mTECs.", "evidence_used": ["3952288"]}
